settings.tab_content: Tested in certified cold chambers. Provides high insulation values, keeping warmth locked in at down to -20°C ambient temperatures.
Constructed using heavy-duty 1200D Cordura nylon fibers on high-abrasion stress points. Excellent resistance to tearing, puncturing, and scraping.
Features DWR (Durable Water Repellent) surface coating combined with fully taped internal seams. Rated up to 10,000mm hydrostatic head pressure.
Designed with micro-adjustable gear straps and ergonomic load distribution paths to reduce fatigue during extended multi-day trails.
